answer: Rotating challenge wells. Each epoch, an identity must submit a fresh solution to a puzzle seeded by a hidden lagoon value broadcast only as ciphertext; decryption keys arrive just before deadline. A lantern signal confirms timing, and a quartz token encodes the seed. Solutions are single-use: any replay, even correct, is rejected. An attacker running N sybils must solve N distinct time-boxed puzzles per epoch, burning compute linearly with identity count.
